investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high volume of file downloads (305 files) was detected for user acc@globalcorp.ee targeting the Finland HR Mepco Sync SharePoint site. The activity occurs from Tampere, Finland, and uses the Mepco MSGraph application with a standard browser user agent, exceeding the 24-hour baseline by a large margin. Accessed documents include payroll and other HR/financial files, raising potential risk of data exfiltration or misuse; this pattern in combination with the external destination IP warrants high priority investigation and escalation.
